_comment: What the character pack offers and how it may be dressed. Read by stagekit.cast, tools/plan.py (period check) and `clip.py cast`. After a new pack release or a new character: `python tools/cast_registry.py merge <notes.json>` then `python tools/clip.py cast --rescan` (parts, colours, height, headwear come from the pack; looks, era, group, stand_in, adapt, adapt_note, props, body are written by hand).

aj.what: the Aj pack: Mixamo-rigged bodies with a drawn mouth atlas and real fingers (packs/aj_rebuild_v1)
